cards.title: The boot rail
items: startup is lazy: no heavy work in App.init or didFinishLaunching, static linking, few dynamic frameworks — the launch budget is measured on an A12/A13-class device
the composition root builds AppEnvironment, the router and the DI graph once; a view never constructs a repository
the router owns a typed [Route] and the path; a deep link is parsed and validated against an allowlist before it becomes a route, and unknown means not-found

cards.title: Every state is rendered
items: the sealed state enum carries loading, empty, ready, offline, forbidden and error — a switch that misses a case does not compile, so a missing state is a build error
a denied notification permission is a state, not a crash; a deleted resource shows not-found
the ViewModel is @MainActor @Observable and never holds a UIView, a UIViewController or a view; effects leave on a single AsyncStream

cards.title: Suspension, drain and exit
items: on background the app keeps only what it needs; a background task drains the outbox while the app is suspended, and the drain resumes on reconnect or foreground
a conflict comes back rejected and visible — the local pending change is never silently overwritten
sign out wipes the Keychain and the GRDB user data together; the OS reclaiming the process is safe only because the state was persisted, and the process may be killed at any moment
